## Gate

- [ ] Any note in this PR is `publishable: cleared` in the vault, reread cold for a stranger
- [ ] No identifiable customers, colleagues or company internals (patterns yes; people and deals never)
- [ ] No en or em dashes (CI checks, this is the reminder)
- [ ] Previewed locally with `hugo server -D`, or happy to trust CI

## After merge

- [ ] Flip the vault note to `status: published`
